 Nishantwa mange tohse,

English translation
(Tum phuljhadi jaisi lagti ho gori,
 tum bam-patakhe jaisi dhamaakedaar lagti ho,
 Nishant tumse bas itna poochhta hai,
 apna phone number batao.)

 Gori-goriya…

HOOK

Chandan badan iya,
 Tohar khushboo ke khazana,
 Aur Nishantwa ba deewana,
 Tohre pichhe, tohre pichhe…

 tumhari khushboo ek khazaane jaisi hai,
 aur Nishant tumhara deewaana hai,
 sirf tumhare peechhe, tumhare peechhe...)

 Top pahinke,
 Gori, paparazzi sabhe
 Tohre photo khiche.

(Jab tum laal rang ka

 gori, saare paparazzi
 tumhari tasveerein kheenchne lagte hain.)

 Tohra chakkar mein rikhadi,
 Tohre upar gaana likhe,
 Baith ke ee likhari.

 tumhare chakkar mein paagal ho gaya hai,
 tumhare upar gaana likhta hai,
 baithkar ye likhne wala.)

 Uho hase lagal,
 Bollas — lag gail ba beta,
 Tohra ishq ke bimari.

 vo bhi hansne lage,

 tumhein uske pyaar ki beemaari lag gayi hai.)

Bani laika Bihari,

 Kabho nahi tute dem.

 tumhare sapne, gori,
 main kabhi tootne nahin doonga.)
Hamra ke dekhe chori chori goriya…
English translation:
(Tum Bollywood ki
 heroine jaisi lagti ho, gori...)
HOOK
Dil kailu chori baljori goriya
 Dil kailu chori baljori goriya
 Dil kailu chori baljori goriya
 Dil kailu chori baljori goriya
English translation:
(Tumne mera dil zabardasti chura liya, gori...)

Bola gori, tohra khatir
 Taj Mahal banwa di ka?
 Bobby Brown ke makeup gori,
 Bulk mein dilwa di ka?
